name: Dual Sync
author: Emilie Gillet
description: Braids' two hard-sync models in one engine: a master oscillator syncs a slave swept up to 64 semitones above it, crossfaded against it. Virtual Analog's sync square shares one knob with pulse width and gain, and has no balance.

controls.label: Balance
controls.description: Crossfades from the master oscillator alone to the synced slave alone.

controls.label: Interval
controls.description: Sets how far above the master the synced slave sits, from unison to just under 64 semitones.

controls.label: Shape
controls.description: Runs from the module's sync square to its sync saw, and through the blend between them that the module has no path to.

controls.label: Reset
controls.description: Moves where in its own cycle the slave restarts on each sync pulse; the module always restarts it at the beginning.

outputs.main: Mono: the master and slave crossfaded at Balance. Stereo: the same sound with a small leftward balance offset.
outputs.aux: Mono: the complementary master/slave crossfade. Stereo: the same sound with a small rightward balance offset.

trigger: Realigns the master and slave oscillator phases so each triggered note starts alike.
upstream: Braids MacroOscillator::RenderDualSync over AnalogOscillator::RenderSquare and RenderSaw
